name: Clash Verge Plus
author: hulingjun, based on jackzasian/omarchy-clash-verge
description: Clash Verge control, multi-subscription automation, quota forecasting and network-change recovery in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Shows the active outbound node, mode and throughput from Clash Verge's local API, and switches nodes, groups, latency-tests and toggles rule/global/TUN from the bar.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the closed widget re-polls. While the panel is open it refreshes every 2 seconds so throughput reads live.

schema.label: Managed subscriptions
schema.description: Comma-separated provider names to show and manage, in display order. Leave empty to manage every HTTP and File provider exposed by Mihomo.

schema.label: Automatic subscription refresh
schema.description: Periodically update every managed HTTP subscription and reload quota counters.

schema.label: Subscription refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often automatic subscription refresh runs.

schema.label: Quota exhaustion forecast
schema.description: Store quota-only history locally and estimate when each subscription will run out at its current usage rate. Subscription URLs are never stored.

schema.label: Quota history retention (days)
schema.description: History window used for quota prediction. A quota reset automatically starts a new prediction cycle.

schema.label: Recover after network changes
schema.description: When the default route changes, close stale Mihomo connections and immediately health-check managed providers.

schema.label: ChatGPT scan provider
schema.description: Provider whose nodes appear in the ChatGPT route assistant. The scan tests every node without switching the current route.

schema.label: ChatGPT routing group
schema.description: Mihomo group changed when you click Use beside a passing ChatGPT node.

schema.label: ChatGPT connectivity test URL
schema.description: URL probed directly through every candidate node. The default asks an OpenAI endpoint that needs no API key and distinguishes a normal unauthenticated response from a blocked route.

schema.label: ChatGPT expected HTTP status
schema.description: Only nodes returning this HTTP status expression pass the ChatGPT scan. 401 is the expected no-credential response from the default OpenAI endpoint; region-blocked routes return a different status.

schema.label: Default group
schema.description: The proxy group the widget steers when it opens. Every other group in your config is one pick away in the panel's group dropdown, so this is only the starting point. Falls back to GLOBAL if this name isn't in your config.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Icon shows the shield alone. Node adds the active outbound node's name. Speed shows live up/down throughput, which also makes the widget poll /connections while closed.

schema.label: Node order
schema.description: How the node list is sorted when the panel opens. Press s in the panel to cycle it without changing this.

schema.label: API socket path
schema.description: Leave empty for Clash Verge's default, /tmp/verge/verge-mihomo.sock. Only set this if you moved it.

schema.label: External controller URL
schema.description: Leave empty to use the unix socket. Set to something like http://127.0.0.1:9097 to talk to a mihomo core over TCP instead — useful when running the core directly rather than through Clash Verge.

schema.label: API secret
schema.description: Only needed when the external controller above has a secret set. Stored in plain text in shell.json, like every other shell setting — leave empty when using the unix socket, which needs no secret.
